overall: The AG found the Egremont Board of Selectmen did not violate the Open Meeting Law on either allegation (inaudible speaking or an inadequate room at the July 22, 2013 meeting) and closed the matter.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged Board members spoke in low voices at the July 22, 2013 special meeting so many attendees could not hear.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by intentionally speaking inaudibly.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the Board failed to provide a meeting room large enough for the overflow crowd at the July 22, 2013 special meeting.
allegations.key_passage: we do not find sufficient evidence to support finding a violation of the Open Meeting Law.
